Definition: from G5259 and G5143 (including its alternate); to run under, i.e. (specially), to sail past:--run under.
BiblicalUsage: The word hypotréchō carries the sense of to run under, to sail close under. In Acts 27:16, the text says "And running under a certain island which is called Clauda."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hypotréchō I do not force more than it gives: to run under, to sail close under.
